page.overview:
Who is Bahr?

Bhar is a talented necromancer and sorcerer as well as the former grand vizier of the Arabyan port city of Copher, now resident in the Imperial city of Middenheim. He's the leader of the Ordo Terribilis, a Chaos Cult allied with the Skaven.

Having proclaimed himself the Magister of the Ordo Terribilis, the necromancer plots the resurgence of the Purple Hand.

The Grand Vizier Bhar fled Araby after his magical malfeasances were exposed. Most Chaos Sorcerers deplore necromancy as the philosophies governing mastery of Undeath conflict with those of the violent mutability that defines the power of Chaos. The vizier has no such qualms, arguing that a synthesis of arcane disciplines making use of Dhar better serves the Dark Gods.

In fact Bahr is also a worshipper of Tzeentch who has gained the ability to summon a Blue Horror to defend him and his assistant, Theodor.
